value.rationale: The archetypal nonlinear cellular automaton has an established 84-cell shortest six-clock. The theorem proves that a doubled clock already exists on 60 cells, but six-cycles do not exist on that ring, and completely determines both supports and labelled primitive-orbit counts at every circumference. This structural nonmonotonicity and exact arithmetic separation answer a motivated space-time periodicity question, rather than an arbitrary finite-size experiment or a routine parameter adjustment.
